title: Landmine Viking Press
summary: A two-handed overhead press using a landmine with a Viking handle, on a forward arc that is easier on the shoulders than a strict press.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: landmine attachment; barbell (Olympic bar); weight plates.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for front delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.6 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.4 for side delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.2 for chest: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly chest total.

setup.text: Stand facing the handle with your feet hip width apart and the grips at shoulder height.
Brace and press up and slightly forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

form_cues.cue: Don't lean back to finish the rep. Ribs down, glutes tight.

mistakes.text: Leaning back to turn it into an incline press.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: One side at a time, Less spinal loading, Palms-up or palms-down grip.
Swap sheet: Less spinal loading, Palms-up or palms-down grip.
Swap sheet: One side at a time, Leg drive helps the press, Less spinal loading.
Swap sheet: More stable, Independent arm levers, Less systemic fatigue.
